note: 생성 건물 설계도. 칸 16px. 설계도가 모양·통행·입구를 정하고 그림은 검사만 받는다. X=건물(막힘·하위) .=땅(통행) D=입구(위 칸 완전 검정+아래 칸 359, 막힘, 아래 칸에 문 이벤트, 바로 아래가 접근칸) *=머리 공간(굴뚝·첨탑·깃발만, 비어도 됨, 상위·통행) G=성문 통로(어두운 개구부, 하위·통행) A=성문 위 성벽 윗면(상위·통행 — 밑으로 지나감). 층 높이: 1층 벽 3칸, 위층마다 2칸. zones(선택)=지붕/벽 구역: R=지붕 윗면(위에서 본 기와) W=앞벽 -=상관없음(박공·머리 공간·땅). R 바로 아래 W 인 경계가 처마선(기준 이미지에 파란 점선).

blueprints.label: L자 2층집
blueprints.subject: a two-story L-shaped village house seen from the top-down 3/4 JRPG camera: a wide back wing across the whole top, and a front wing projecting toward the viewer on the RIGHT side only; the empty lower-left corner is an open yard (stays magenta). Big orange clay-tile roofs seen from above cover everything above the blue eave lines; the front wing's roof runs down to a small front gable just above its wall. White plaster walls with dark timber framing, gray stone plinth, windows on both stories, one chimney.
blueprints.note: 뒷동 처마선을 파란 점선만 줬을 때 9장 중 6장이 5~11도트 위(벽이 김) → 지붕 구역을 옅은 주황으로 칠해 줌(zoneTint).

blueprints.label: 3층 대저택
blueprints.subject: a grand three-story noble manor seen from the top-down 3/4 JRPG camera (NOT a front elevation): a wide symmetric main block whose long orange clay-tile ridge roof, seen from above, covers the whole top half down to one straight eave on the blue line, with two chimneys and a few small dormer windows sitting inside the roof area; below the eave the three-story front wall with rows of windows on every story, white plaster, dark timber framing, gray stone plinth; a one-story entrance hall projecting one square toward the viewer at the bottom center, with its own small orange roof (the blue-lined box) and the double black doorway in its front wall.
blueprints.note: 3층 앞벽 7칸(1층 3 + 위층 2+2)은 AI 가 3/3 모두 7.7~9.7칸으로 그려 8칸으로 늘림(설계도가 부자연스러웠음). 지붕 8칸은 그대로. 현관 지붕 2칸은 AI 가 3/3 한 칸 낮게 그려(현관 앞벽 = 문 높이 2칸) 14~15행으로 내림. 점선만으로는 처마가 7.5~9행을 오감 → zoneTint.

blueprints.label: 성
blueprints.subject: a stone castle drawn EXACTLY on the dotted outline: the four corner towers are SQUARE blocks exactly 4 grid squares wide with battlements on top (do not make them round or bigger than their dotted squares); the side walls are exactly 3 grid squares thick, the back wall exactly 4 squares deep and the front wall exactly 5 squares tall (top walkway with crenellations seen from above, then the stone wall face); an open gateway passage in the middle of the front wall; a tall central keep, exactly 8 squares wide, at the back of the courtyard with its own black doorway, narrow slit windows and red banners. Gray stone like the style guide. The magenta area enclosed by the walls is an open courtyard seen from above — keep it magenta, do not let towers or walls bulge into it.

blueprints.label: 1층 오두막
blueprints.subject: a small one-story village cottage: an orange clay-tile roof seen from above covering the top half, one chimney, a white plaster front wall with dark timber posts, one small window beside the black doorway, gray stone plinth.

blueprints.label: 넓은 1층 농가
blueprints.subject: a wide one-story farmer's cottage: a deep orange clay-tile roof seen from above with one chimney, a white plaster front wall with dark timber framing, two small windows with flower boxes, gray stone plinth, the black doorway on the left side.

blueprints.label: 2층 좁은 집
blueprints.subject: a narrow two-story townhouse: an orange clay-tile roof seen from above with a small dormer and a chimney, a white plaster front wall with dark timber framing, windows on both stories, gray stone plinth, black doorway.

blueprints.label: 2층 여관
blueprints.subject: a long two-story village inn: a big orange clay-tile roof seen from above with two chimneys and three small dormers, a white plaster front wall with dark timber framing, a row of windows on both stories, a wooden sign board with a mug painted on it hanging on the wall beside the wide double black doorway, gray stone plinth.

blueprints.label: 종탑 예배당
blueprints.subject: a village chapel: a long nave with an orange clay-tile roof seen from above on both sides, and a square stone bell tower in the middle of the front whose pointed spire rises into the light gray headroom above; the bell tower stands on the gray outline above the roof line. One tall front wall (4 squares, a single tall hall) of pale stone with two tall arched stained-glass windows and a round rose window above the wide double black doorway.

blueprints.label: 대장간
blueprints.subject: a village blacksmith's workshop: an orange clay-tile roof seen from above with one big square stone forge chimney, a front wall of gray stone blocks and dark timber (no plaster), a wide shop window with a warm orange forge glow inside, an anvil-and-horseshoe sign board on the wall, black doorway.

blueprints.label: 잡화점
blueprints.subject: a small village general store: an orange clay-tile roof seen from above with a chimney, a white plaster front wall with dark timber framing, a wide shop display window under a red-and-cream striped cloth awning (the awning stays inside the outline, on the wall), a hanging sign board, black doorway.

blueprints.label: 곳간
blueprints.subject: a large wooden farm barn: a big orange clay-tile roof seen from above, one tall front wall (4 squares, a single tall space) made of vertical dark brown wooden planks with timber beams (no plaster), a small hay-loft hatch high on the wall, the wide double black doorway at the bottom center, gray stone plinth.

blueprints.label: L자 2층집(좌우 반전)
blueprints.subject: a two-story L-shaped village house seen from the top-down 3/4 JRPG camera: a wide back wing across the whole top, and a front wing projecting toward the viewer on the LEFT side only; the empty lower-right corner is an open yard (stays magenta). Big orange clay-tile roofs seen from above cover everything above the blue eave lines; the front wing's roof runs down to a small front gable just above its wall. White plaster walls with dark timber framing, gray stone plinth, windows on both stories, one chimney.

blueprints.label: 물레방앗간
blueprints.subject: a riverside watermill: an orange clay-tile roof seen from above with one stone chimney, a front wall of gray stone blocks on the left part and dark timber planks on the right part, and a LARGE round wooden water wheel with paddles mounted on the right part of the front wall, its lower half dipping below the wall into a short stone water channel at the bottom right; a small window and the black doorway on the left part, gray stone plinth.

blueprints.label: 마을 정문
blueprints.subject: the fortified main gate of a medieval village: two square gray stone gate towers on the left and right, joined above the road by a covered timber gallery; one orange clay-tile roof seen from above covers the towers and the gallery; the front wall is gray stone with narrow arrow-slit windows and small red banners with a golden emblem; in the middle an open dark arched gate passage that the road runs through (no door leaves, no portcullis).

blueprints.label: 나무 망루
blueprints.subject: a tall wooden village watchtower: a square timber tower of dark brown log planks with cross braces, a lookout platform near the top with a wooden railing, a small pointed orange clay-tile roof on top seen from above, a small red flag on the roof rising into the light gray headroom, a narrow black doorway at the bottom center, gray stone footing.

blueprints.label: 풍차
blueprints.subject: a village windmill: a round white plaster and gray stone tower, a small cone-shaped orange clay-tile cap on top seen from above, and FOUR big wooden lattice sails in an X shape fixed to the front of the cap; the sails spread out into the light gray dotted area around the top of the tower (the sails are allowed there), a small window and the black doorway at the bottom of the tower.
blueprints.headroom: The area outlined with LIGHT GRAY dots around the top of the tower is room for the windmill SAILS: the four big sails spread out into it in an X shape (they may cover most of it); leave the rest of it magenta. Nothing else goes there.

blueprints.label: 마법사의 탑
blueprints.subject: a wizard's tower: a tall round tower of pale gray stone with dark slate-blue conical roof seen from above, a glowing pale-blue crystal orb on top of the roof tip rising into the light gray headroom, tall narrow windows glowing pale blue, a small balcony, climbing ivy at the base, a star-and-moon banner hanging on the wall, a black arched doorway at the bottom center, gray stone plinth.

blueprints.label: 모험가 길드
blueprints.subject: an adventurers' guild hall: a large two-story building, a big orange clay-tile roof seen from above with a chimney and two dormers, a front wall of white plaster with dark timber framing on the upper story and gray stone on the ground floor, a big wooden sign with a crossed swords and shield emblem over the wide double black doorway, a quest notice board with pinned papers on the wall beside it, rows of windows, red banners.

blueprints.label: 닭장
blueprints.subject: a small wooden chicken coop: an orange clay-tile roof seen from above, a front wall of rough brown wooden planks with a little round hatch and a tiny wooden ramp, on short wooden legs; no door.

blueprints.label: 건초 수레
blueprints.subject: a wooden farm hand cart loaded with a pile of golden hay, two big wooden wheels, handles pointing to the left.

blueprints.label: 건초 더미
blueprints.subject: two round golden hay bales tied with twine, one stacked leaning on the other.

blueprints.label: 빛나는 수정
blueprints.subject: a cluster of tall glowing pale-blue magic crystals growing out of a small gray rock, with a soft light glow on the crystals only.

blueprints.label: 요정 버섯
blueprints.subject: a small patch of three red-capped white-spotted fairy mushrooms of different sizes, with a few tiny glowing dots.

blueprints.label: 들꽃
blueprints.subject: a small loose clump of wild meadow flowers: a few tiny white, yellow and pale purple blossoms on short green stems, low to the ground, sparse (the magenta background shows between the stems).

blueprints.label: 이끼 바위
blueprints.subject: one medium gray boulder with a little green moss on top, rounded, sitting on the ground.

blueprints.label: 그루터기
blueprints.subject: an old cut tree stump with visible rings on top, brown bark, two small roots, a tiny mushroom at its base.

blueprints.label: 갈대
blueprints.subject: a clump of tall green riverside reeds and two brown cattails.
